environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless function deployed on AWS EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) in namespace 'prod-graphql'. Pod runs with default service account. No NetworkPolicy objects applied to the namespace. IMDSv2 is enabled but the pod has the token hop limit set to 2. The GraphQL endpoint is exposed via AWS ALB Ingress without any request filtering. Hibernate ORM is configured with a PostgreSQL backend containing sensitive asset records.
